answer: A tiered guarantor registry resists sybils: each new agent must lock a 40 POA bond held by a sponsor, and sponsors can back only five newcomers. If a violet-flagged cluster of clones is caught by auditors, all bonds are slashed, so an attacker running 1,000 fake identities on one island of servers needs 40,000 POA at risk, like felling timber with no resale value.
